world.scenario: You have been captured by the Obsidian Guard and imprisoned in Block A's solitary confinement cell. The only way out is to bypass four security layers: disarm your cell door, hack the corridor safe, breach the heavy blast doors of the control room, and finally override the main power grid to escape through the emergency chute.
world.objective: Navigate the prison from Cell to Control Room to Power Core and Escape Chute by solving a chain of mechanical and digital puzzles.

rooms.description: A damp, narrow solitary confinement cell. The heavy iron door is barred shut. A small desk holds your personal effects. A rusted ventilation grate sits above the toilet.

The main corridor is lit by flickering fluorescent lights. A digital keypad safe blocks the path to the next cell block. To the left, a maintenance closet door stands slightly ajar. To the right, a fire extinguisher hangs on the wall.

The Control Room. A massive steel blast door separates you from the outer world. On the wall is a fuse panel with several switches labeled 'PUMP', 'LIGHTS', and 'DOOR_OVERRIDE'. A heavy wrench rests on a workbench.

The Power Core. The emergency escape chute is locked tight, requiring a manual override code to open. A terminal displays the current grid status: 'GRID_LOCKED'. A small box of spare fuses sits nearby.

objects.description: The heavy iron door of the solitary cell.
A jagged piece of metal torn from a guard's belt.
A digital keypad safe blocking the corridor.
A small tag stuck to the fire extinguisher.
The massive steel blast doors leading to the outer world.
A heavy-duty wrench found in the control room.
A diagram showing the sequence of fuses to activate.
The current state of the prison power grid.
A pile of dusty chairs and tables.

rules: Every object requires_code must be satisfied by a contains_info token from an upstream taken object.
Every tool chain must start with a visible or unlocked takeable object.
No circular dependencies exist between tools and locks.
Goal completion in each room is the sole prerequisite to access the next room.
solution_path: 1. Examine rusty_knife_hole in room_1 to get info 'the object'.
2. Use the object on the object in room_1 (locked) -> unlocks it and reveals the object.
3. Retrieve the object from the object.
4. Enter code the hidden code into corridor_safe in room_2 -> unlocks it.
5. Examine fire_extinguisher in room_2 to get info 'the object'.
6. Use the object on maintenance_clue_tag in room_2 (hidden behind extinguisher) -> reveals the object.
8. Examine fuse_panel_overview in room_3 to get info 'sequence_A_B_C'.
9. Use the object on the object in room_3 (locked) -> unlocks it.
10. Enter code sequence_A_B_C into the object -> triggers blast_doors unlock.
11. Retrieve info 'sequence_A_B_C' from fuse_panel_overview (consumed by previous step).
12. Use industrial_wrench on blast_doors in room_3 (locked) -> unlocks them.
13. Retrieve info 'code_the hidden code' from fuse_box in room_4.
14. Enter code the hidden code into emergency_chute in room_4 -> unlocks it.
